question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
leg_first AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, lt.term_start as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    INNER JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide AND lt.term_start = ft.first_term_start
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT 0 as interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        lf.id_bioguide,
        lf.state,
        l.gender,
        i.interval,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = lf.id_bioguide 
            AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= DATE_TRUNC('year', TRY_CAST(lf.first_term_start AS DATE)) + INTERVAL ((i.interval + 1) * 1) YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY
            AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) >= DATE_TRUNC('year', TRY_CAST(lf.first_term_start AS DATE)) + INTERVAL ((i.interval + 1) * 1) YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_retained
    FROM leg_first lf
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
    JOIN legislators l ON lf.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lf.id_bioguide, lf.state, lf.first_term_start, l.gender, i.interval
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT state, gender, interval, AVG(1.0 * is_retained) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, interval
),
state_gender_all_nonzero AS (
    SELECT state, gender
    FROM state_gender_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING MIN(retention_rate) > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT sgr.state
FROM state_gender_retention sgr
INNER JOIN state_gender_all_nonzero sga_m ON sgr.state = sga_m.state AND sga_m.gender = 'M'
INNER JOIN state_gender_all_nonzero sga_f ON sgr.state = sga_f.state AND sga_f.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY sgr.state
ORDER BY sgr.state
